digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate / asserted-capability criterion (G6/E4 rubric family)
propositions: Plan asserts a named module provides a capability, but the module lacks that capability (cases: dc58 signing in completion.py, db7b REVIEW_RESULT compaction in compact.py)
Plan asserts a capability must be built or is absent, but a named module already provides it (case: 5886 unmapped-Jira-status alert in fetcher.py)
The new asserted-capability criterion must be registered as advisory in G6/E4 rubric family, non-orphan across registry, routing, and guide, executable as AGENT-tier code-grounded agentic finder

Deterministic unit tests and bounded sanity check (6 live criterion runs: 3 E1-verified misses as must-fire, 3 clean plans as must-not-fire) must demonstrate >=66% recall on misses and advisory-only posture on false positives
The criterion must auto-flow into the standing effectiveness recorder without per-criterion wiring and cite the advisory→blocking promotion gate documented in plan-review-gate.md

Landed through Gerrit (change #805, merge d08f3484, votes LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1, CI green) with bounded sanity results recorded (1.0 recall on misses, 0.33 false-accept rate on clean plans as dogfood signal)
